hits.snippet: # Parallel Studios Secures $35M in Funding for Ethereum NFT Game Parallel and AI-Powered Colony Parallel Studios, the startup behind the popular Ethereum NFT card-battler game Parallel, has [announced](https://twitter.com/ParallelTCG/status/1773157742095511889) a successful funding round, raising $35 million from major firms in the crypto ... The funding comes from prominent names such as investment management giant VanEck, Solana Ventures, the Base Ecosystem Fund, Collab + Currency, and The Spartan Group. ... This latest round of funding follows Parallel's previous raise of $50 million from Paradigm in 2021, which valued the studio at $500 million. While the updated valuation and the format of the recent funding round were not disclosed, Parallel Studios did share some insights into how they plan to utilize the $35 million infusion. ... Funding from this round will contribute to the development of Wayfinder, an on-chain AI protocol that powers Colony and potentially other applications and games.
